title: Elevate
description: Organization-managed settings for Elevate (preference domain no.reothor.elevate). Leave a setting out to leave the choice to the user; every setting you send is locked and shows a "Managed by your organization" caption in the app.
__comment: Jamf Pro > Computers > Configuration Profiles > Application & Custom Settings > External Applications: source 'Custom Schema', preference domain 'no.reothor.elevate', then upload this file.

ClientId.title: Application (client) id
ClientId.description: The Entra application (client) id Elevate signs in with, as a GUID. Leave out to let each user enter their own.

DisableUpdateCheck.title: Disable the update check
DisableUpdateCheck.description: true stops the daily GitHub releases check and hides the update user interface. Leave out to let the check run.

AllowedSignInMethods.title: Allowed sign-in methods
AllowedSignInMethods.description: The sign-in methods users may add accounts with (custom is Other app (browser sign-in)). Leave out or empty to allow all of them.

AllowedTenants.title: Allowed tenants
AllowedTenants.description: Tenant ids or verified domains users may add or discover. Leave out for no restriction.

PinnedTenants.title: Pinned tenants
PinnedTenants.description: Tenant ids or verified domains tracked automatically for every account that can reach them.

ManagedProfiles.title: Managed profiles (inline)
ManagedProfiles.description: A profile set as a JSON document, in the format of docs/enterprise/keys.md. Published profiles can be run but not edited or deleted.

ManagedProfilesUrl.title: Managed profiles URL
ManagedProfilesUrl.description: An https:// URL serving the same profile set, fetched once a day. http:// URLs are ignored.

OrganizationName.title: Organization name
OrganizationName.description: Your organization's name, shown beside Elevate's own (never instead of it): 1-32 characters. Required before the three keys below take effect.

OrganizationTitleStyle.title: Organization title style
OrganizationTitleStyle.description: How the name is phrased beside Elevate's own. by: "by Contoso". managedBy: "Managed by Contoso". none: no header caption, but Settings and the support contact stay. Leave out for by.

OrganizationSupportUrl.title: Organization support URL
OrganizationSupportUrl.description: An https:// URL for your help desk. http:// URLs are ignored.

OrganizationSupportEmail.title: Organization support email
OrganizationSupportEmail.description: An email address for your help desk, offered as a mailto: link.
